name: HH 212

images.credit: Lee et al. 2021, Fig. 1a (878 um total intensity, crop)

paper.title: What Produces Dust Polarization in the HH 212 Protostellar Disk at 878 μm: Dust Self-scattering or Dichroic Extinction?

notes: Class 0 protostellar disk driving the HH 212 jet; ALMA 878um dust polarization (~0.03 arcsec resolution) resolves a nearly edge-on disk with V-shaped polarization structures and 'arm' features (Lin et al. 2021, arXiv:2102.11481), attributed to dichroic extinction / self-scattering by grains near the disk midplane.
